rules.title: Contract value
rules.text: The contract must state the total contract value, or the fee and how it is calculated.

rules.title: Termination notice
rules.text: The contract must allow termination by written notice, and the notice period must be at least 30 days.

rules.title: Director signature
rules.applies_to: contracts with a total value over 500,000 THB
rules.text: A contract whose total value is over 500,000 THB must be signed for the company by a director (กรรมการ). A manager's signature is not enough.

rules.title: Service levels
rules.text: A service contract must define service levels, including a maximum response time when a problem is reported.

rules.title: Personal data protection
rules.applies_to: contracts where the supplier processes personal data for the company
rules.text: If the supplier will process personal data on the company's behalf, the contract must contain a data protection clause that refers to the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

rules.title: Governing law
rules.text: The contract must be governed by the laws of Thailand.

rules.title: Payment terms
rules.text: Payment must fall due no sooner than 30 days after the company receives a correct invoice.

rules.title: Warranty
rules.text: A contract to buy goods must give a warranty of at least 12 months.
